issue.title: Neovim crashes if pressing the toggle command in fzf inside toggleterm

repository.name: toggleterm.nvim
repository.description: A neovim lua plugin to help easily manage multiple terminal windows

issue.body:
![togggleterm_bug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/64891486/161282744-59dc7285-25c2-4abc-a105-2557fdcebdbf.gif)

My toggle command is ```<C-c>```.
As you can see, the first time I pressed ```<C-c>```, it successfully toggled the terminal off, but the second time, neovim crashed.

Here's my config:

```lua
local status_ok, toggleterm = pcall(require, "toggleterm")
if not status_ok then
	return
end

local opt = { noremap = true }
local map = vim.api.nvim_set_keymap
-- local opts = { noremap = true, silent = true }

toggleterm.setup({
	size = 20,
	open_mapping = [[<C-c>]],
	hide_numbers = true,
	shade_filetypes = {},
	shade_terminals = true,
	shading_factor = 2,
	start_in_insert = true,
	insert_mappings = true,
	terminal_mappings = true,
	persist_size = true,
	direction = "float",
	close_on_exit = true,
	shell = vim.o.shell,
	float_opts = {
		border = "curved",
		winblend = 0,
		highlights = {
			border = "Normal",
			background = "Normal",
		},
	},
})

function _G.set_terminal_keymaps()
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_keymap(0, "t", "<C-q>", [[<C-\><C-n>]], opt)
	-- vim.api.nvim_buf_set_keymap(0, "t", "<C-h>", [[<C-\><C-n><C-W>h]], opt)
	-- vim.api.nvim_buf_set_keymap(0, "t", "<C-j>", [[<C-\><C-n><C-W>j]], opt)
	-- vim.api.nvim_buf_set_keymap(0, "t", "<C-k>", [[<C-\><C-n><C-W>k]], opt)
	-- vim.api.nvim_buf_set_keymap(0, "t", "<C-l>", [[<C-\><C-n><C-W>l]], opt)
end

vim.cmd("autocmd! TermOpen term://* lua set_terminal_keymaps()")

local Terminal = require("toggleterm.terminal").Terminal
local lazygit = Terminal:new({ cmd = "lazygit", hidden = true })

function _LAZYGIT_TOGGLE()
	lazygit:toggle()
end

-- map("t", "<esc>", "<C-\\><C-N>", opts)
map("n", "<Leader>gg", ":lua _LAZYGIT_TOGGLE()<CR>", opt)
```

I tried changing my toggle command to ```<C-t>``` and the bug is still there.

body: Maybe #16699. Do you have a backtrace?
I don't really know how  to get a backtrace, can you point me towards the proper documentation ?

Thank you, here's what I have (I reproduced the bug successfully right before generating the backtrace file), I hope it's what you need:
[bt.txt](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/files/8399596/bt.txt)

Can you try to see if this solves the problem:
```
sudo pacman -Sdd --asdeps libvterm
```
and replace `libvterm-0.1` with `libvterm`.

You will still need `libvterm-0-1` for building Nvim though.

Yes I'm on nightly. Should I try to reproduce with stable ?
No, I did not mean that.

You can try to seem if this solves the problem then:
1. Install `neovim-git` from AUR (this builds Nvim from source and installs `libvterm-0.1`)
2. Run `sudo pacman -Sdd --asdeps libvterm` and replace `libvterm-0.1` with `libvterm`

> You can try to seem if this solves the problem then:
> 
> 1. Install `neovim-git` from AUR (this builds Nvim from source and installs `libvterm-0.1`)
> 2. Run `sudo pacman -Sdd --asdeps libvterm` and replace `libvterm-0.1` with `libvterm`

Yes it fixed the issue ! I keep toggling and it doesn't crashes anymore ! Thanks, legend!

You can use this as the workaround until a libvterm 0.2 version bump PR is merged (#17329). Right now #17329 is blocked by a libvterm bug. Since libvterm 0.2 fixes this issue, this is a duplicate of #16699.

This issue has been mentioned on **Neovim Discourse**. There might be relevant details there:

https://neovim.discourse.group/t/how-to-debug-intermittent-neovim-freezes/2225/4
